source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: A plain note of three lines; the second begins with 'Claude responded:'. No line begins with a user label.

Apple takes the note for share-page text, drops the line above the speaker line and the text on it, and stores 'More notes.' as an assistant message. The web app asks for a user header and an assistant header before it reads text as a share page. Here there is no user header, so the generic parser reads the text: the first line is kept as a note, and 'Claude responded:' is a marker of that parser.
